meta.title: Your own picture and its mask
meta.about: Load a file from the input folder, then see the picture and the mask apart. No model.
needs: An image called example.png in your input folder. Pick your own in the loader.

notes.1: Reads from the input folder and returns two things: IMAGE and MASK.
notes.3: Turns the mask into a picture you can look at.
notes.4: White means the mask is 1: for LoadImage, a transparent pixel. A file with no alpha gives an all-zero mask.
